name: Scotland
description: Scotland is a devolved nation within the United Kingdom with its own parliament, legal system and distinct cultural identity. Center of the Enlightenment and nineteenth-century heavy industry, it now blends North Sea energy, whisky and food exports, financial services in Edinburgh, and growing renewables. Devolution since 1999 gives Holyrood powers over health, education and justice.

works.title: Actor Set Evolution
works.description: Temporal mapping of Scotland's actor space from Enlightenment institutions and imperial-era shipbuilding through nationalized industries to the devolved parliament, energy operators, and Edinburgh's fund-management cluster.

works.title: North Sea Energy and Export Network
works.description: Network analysis of offshore oil, gas and wind assets, distilling and food-export supply chains, and their fiscal and employment linkages across the UK.

works.title: Devolved Territorial Structure
works.description: Geospatial representation of council areas, island authorities, and the reserved-devolved boundary shaping infrastructure, energy consenting and public services.
